q: Why does LRU beat FIFO under skewed traffic?
a: Hits refresh recency so the hot working set sticks, while FIFO evicts hot keys as readily as scan keys.

q: What does LFU protect against that LRU does not?
a: Scans: single-touch keys never build frequency, so they cannot dislodge hot entries.

q: When do all policies perform equally?
a: Under uniform demand every key is equally cold, so capacity churns the same for fifo, lru, and lfu.

q: What should you ask before picking a policy?
a: The key distribution: skew rewards recency/frequency tracking, uniformity rewards capacity.
